name: attention-diet
description: One attention contract for the sources you choose, and a short briefing that ends: source links, explicit limits and memory of previously shown items.

interface.shortDescription: Your chosen sources. One short briefing.
interface.longDescription: Choose the sources, topics and limits for your briefing. Attention Diet checks your sources, such as the newsletters and alerts in your inbox or the RSS feeds of writers and channels you follow, selects useful items with source links, and remembers previously shown item versions. Set it up, run it once, tune what reaches you, or view your contract as one readable page. Requires Python, and a supported browser or authenticated connector for sources that are not feeds; access and coverage depend on the selected sources.
defaultPrompt: Use Attention Diet to set up my two-minute briefing.
Use Attention Diet to check my sources once.
Use Attention Diet to show me fewer promotional posts.
Use Attention Diet to show me my contract.
